rows.detail: no incidents classified yet — taxonomy ready (blocked-request / rate-limit / suspicious-pattern / security-incident / notice)
rows.hint: see scripts/SECURITY.md section 3; a blocked request or throttle is never counted as a compromise.

rows.detail: live backend online (https://twocchurch-site.onrender.com); local dist not built (dev mode ok)
rows.hint: single instance keeps in-memory rate buckets exact; if ever scaled horizontally add sticky sessions.

rows.detail: server-side hash sign-in + 2FA + per-connection/network throttles — but ADMIN_HASH_OVERRIDE not set, so diskless sleeps fall back to the shipped default
rows.hint: set ADMIN_HASH_OVERRIDE to the 64-hex SHA-256 of the office password (never the password) in the host dashboard.

rows.detail: publish / undoPublish / password changes / adopt doors require a signed-in admin session; adopt token rotates on restart; publish rate-limited per IP
rows.hint: public reads stay public by design; every write takes a live session checked server-side.

rows.detail: no published store and no snapshots yet — nothing to lose, nothing to restore
rows.hint: publish once, then run npm run backup; snapshots land in data-backups/ (kept out of git).

rows.detail: SQLi / XSS / traversal / command-injection / LFI / sensitive-file / SSRF / oversized-URL blocked (403); legit pages + publish bodies allowed; tiered 429 buckets armed
rows.hint: repeat probes throttle automatically; block at the host firewall only if one IP persists.
